## Checks

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] Plugin changes: `npm run check` (or `typecheck`) passes in the plugin folder
- [ ] Skill or plugin files changed: `MANIFEST.json` regenerated in a separate commit, or I asked the maintainer to do it
- [ ] Docs updated for behavior changes
- [ ] No credentials, private host names, IP addresses, or personal paths
- [ ] Adapted material carries its upstream license and a THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES entry
